description: Use this when the user wants to read a script in a live teleprompter. Accepts up to 30,000 characters, a whole-number speed from 60 to 300 words per minute or a target duration, text size, mirror mode, and a 0 to 10 second countdown. Returns word count and duration; the full script is shown only in the widget. Numeric pause cues accept whole seconds from 1 to 86,400 per cue. Does not record video or audio.

countdown_seconds.description: Seconds to wait after Start before scrolling, e.g. 3.

mirror.description: Flip the script horizontally for a glass teleprompter, e.g. true.

script.description: Speech script, up to 30,000 characters; numeric pause cues accept whole seconds from 1 to 86,400, e.g. Welcome everyone. [PAUSE 2] Today we will discuss our plan.

speed.description: Optional whole-number reading speed from 60 to 300 wpm when target_duration_seconds is not used, e.g. 130.

target_duration_seconds.description: Optional desired total duration in seconds including pause cues, e.g. 300.

text_size.description: Initial script text size in pixels, e.g. 28.

name: show_teleprompter
title: Show teleprompter
